senses.gloss: m.(b. h. תְּבַלֻּל; בָּלַל)mixture, blending of the colors of the eye. Sifra Emor, ch. II, Par. 3 ת׳ לבן נכנס בשחור וכ׳ t’ballul means the white of the eye invading the black, or the reverse; (oth. opin.) לבן פוסק וכ׳, v. סִירָה II; Bekh. VI, 2.
units: ib. 38ᵇ מהו לשון ת׳ דבר המבלבל וכ׳ what is the meaning of t’ballul? Anything that disturbs the arrangement of the eye, v. בִּלְבֵּל.—Pl. תְּבַלּוּלִים, תְּבלּוּלִין.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 9:5:2">Y. Pes. IX, 36ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>דוקים ות׳ פוסלין בו</he> cataracts and blendings make it unfit for the Passover sacrifice; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 8:11">Tosef. Pes. VIII, 11</cite> <he>פסח מצרים לא נהגו דקין ות׳ וכ׳</he> for the Passover in Egypt they did not consider cataracts and blendings to be disqualifications, but for the regular Passover they did &c.
